structure.unit: Civil Actions; Commencement, Pleadings, and Motions

law.catch_line: Electronic filings in civil actions in circuit court
law.text: Electronic filings in civil actions and proceedings in the circuit court shall be governed by Article 4.1 (§ 17.1-258.2 et. seq.) of Chapter 2 of Title 17.1 and applicable Rules of the Supreme Court of Virginia.
